changesFromV1: ROUND family: multiples of 100 within +-500 of session open (Osler 2003, FRBNY SR125)
primaryAnalysis: All sessions pooled, 12 cells, Holm across 12, BASE 2 ticks.
decisionRule: A cell is a candidate only if pHolm<0.05 AND meanRNet>0 AND day-cluster 95% CI lower bound >0 AND n>=100. Candidates are not tradable; they become a single pre-registered hypothesis for forward/holdout testing. Additionally: excess over control minus synthetic null bias must be >0.
knownCaveat: This training window has already been used by ~30 earlier CRU-60 hypotheses (different rules). Results are exploratory. V2 was designed after seeing V1 results (event counts motivated change 1).
